claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Moxonidine is a high-affinity imidazoline I1/alpha2-adrenergic agonist with no intrinsic cytotoxic activity; at 2.5 uM it is expected to produce little or no cell killing in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
